question: Should a team down one late pull its goalie on a power play?
answer: Yes, with 3:00 or less left. 6v4 adds 8 points of tie chance at 2:00. Past 4:00 the gain isn't clear.
findings: 5v4 trailing in the 3rd period: 8.5 GF/60 (7.9-9.1) and 1.2 GA/60, over 5,159 min.
On a minor with 2:00 left, down 1, a team is level at 60:00 31% of the time at 6v4 and 24% at 5v4 (difference CI 3 to 12 points).
On a minor with 4:00 left, the gain is +3.7 points (-0.4 to 7.6), which I can't tell apart from zero.
method: The outcome is being level or ahead at 60:00. A Markov model of a 2:00 minor, 6v4 against 5v4 followed by the optimal even-strength pull, with rates from trailing teams in the 3rd period. 6v4 time is chosen late, so its rates carry selection.
data: NHL API play-by-play + shift charts, regular seasons 2021-22 to 2024-25, 5,248 games.
split_check: The gain at 2:00 left was +9 points in 2021-23 and +6 points in 2023-25.
